<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
  <title>Pythagoras Theorem GCSE Mathematics</title>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="800" height="500" fill="white"/>

  <!-- Title -->
  <text x="400" y="40" font-family="Arial" font-size="24" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle" fill="black">Pythagoras' Theorem: a² + b² = c²</text>

  <!-- Right-Angled Triangle (Vertices: A(220, 360), B(220, 180), C(420, 360)) -->
  <!-- Side b (Vertical): height = 180, from (220,180) to (220,360) -->
  <polygon points="220,180 220,360 420,360" fill="white" stroke="black" stroke-width="3"/>

  <!-- Right Angle Symbol -->
  <polyline points="220,340 240,340 240,360" fill="none" stroke="black" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Square on side a (base) - below triangle: y from 360 to 560 (clipped visually or fit in viewBox) -->
  <!-- Adjusted base: from (220,320) to (420,320), triangle points: A(220,320), B(220,160), C(420,320) -->
  <!-- Let's redefine triangle cleanly for viewBox (0 to 800, 0 to 500): -->
  <!-- Triangle A: (200, 340), B: (200, 180), C: (380, 340) -->
  <!-- Let's clear and redraw with perfect coordinates -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="800" height="500" fill="white"/>
  <text x="400" y="35" font-family="Arial" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle" fill="#222">Pythagoras' Theorem: a² + b² = c²</text>

  <!-- Main Triangle: Vertices (240,340), (240,180), (380,340) -> base = 140, height = 160 -->
  <!-- Let's use clean numbers: base b = 150 (from 200 to 350), height a = 200 (from 350 to 150) -->
  <!-- Vertices: P1(200,350) right angle, P2(200,150), P3(350,350) -->
  
  <!-- Square on side a (vertical, height 200): x from 0 to 200, y from 150 to 350 -->
  <rect x="0" y="150" width="200" height="200" fill="#E3F2FD" stroke="#1565C0" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="100" y="255" font-family="Arial" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle" fill="#0D47A1">a²</text>
  <text x="100" y="140" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" text-anchor="middle" fill="#333">Side a (200)</text>

  <!-- Square on side b (base, width 150): x from 200 to 350, y from 350 to 500 -->
  <rect x="200" y="350" width="150" height="150" fill="#E8F5E9" stroke="#2E7D32" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="275" y="430" font-family="Arial" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1B5E20">b²</text>
  <text x="370" y="430" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" text-anchor="middle" fill="#333">Side b (150)</text>

  <!-- Triangle itself -->
  <polygon points="200,150 200,350 350,350" fill="#FFFDE7" stroke="#333" stroke-width="3"/>
  
  <!-- Right angle marker -->
  <polyline points="200,330 220,330 220,350" fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Triangle side labels -->
  <text x="180" y="250" font-family="Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1565C0">a</text>
  <text x="275" y="375" font-family="Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle" fill="#2E7D32">b</text>
  <text x="260" y="235" font-family="Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle" fill="#C62828">Hypotenuse (c)</text>

  <!-- Hypotenuse square (c²): constructed outwards from hypotenuse between (200,150) and (350,350) -->
  <!-- Vector from (200,150) to (350,350) is dx=150, dy=200. Perpendicular outward is (-200, 150). -->
  <!-- Corner 4: 200 - 200 = 0, 150 + 150 = 300 -->
  <!-- Corner 3: 350 - 200 = 150, 350 + 150 = 500 -> wait, let's use exact coordinates for c² square: -->
  <!-- Polygon for c²: (200,150) (350,350) (150, 500) (0, 300) -> let's check: vector (150,200), perp (-200,150) -->
  <!-- P_top(200,150) + (-200,150) = (0, 300) -->
  <!-- P_right(350,350) + (-200,150) = (150, 500) -->
  <!-- Let's verify right angles: dot product (150,200).(-200,150) = -30000 + 30000 = 0. Perfect! -->
  <polygon points="200,150 350,350 150,500 0,300" fill="#FFEBEE" stroke="#C62828" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="125" y="325" font-family="Arial" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle" fill="#B71C1C">c²</text>

  <!-- Explanatory Text Box on the Right -->
  <rect x="430" y="80" width="340" height="380" rx="10" ry="10" fill="#F8F9FA" stroke="#DEE2E6" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="450" y="120" font-family="Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#212529">Key Fact for GCSE:</text>
  <text x="450" y="160" font-family="Arial" font-size="15" fill="#495057">1. The longest side is the hypotenuse (c).</text>
  <text x="450" y="195" font-family="Arial" font-size="15" fill="#495057">2. It is always opposite the right angle.</text>
  <text x="450" y="230" font-family="Arial" font-size="15" fill="#495057">3. Area of square a² + Area of square b²</text>
  <text x="475" y="260" font-family="Arial" font-size="15" fill="#495057">= Area of square c².</text>

  <!-- Formula Highlight Box -->
  <rect x="450" y="290" width="300" height="70" rx="5" ry="5" fill="#FFF" stroke="#6C757D" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="600" y="320" font-family="Arial" font-size="20" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle" fill="#0D6EFD">a² + b² = c²</text>
  <text x="600" y="345" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle" fill="#6C757D">Use to find missing side lengths</text>

  <!-- Animated educational indicator: Pulsing circle highlighting the right angle and formula connection -->
  <circle cx="200" cy="350" r="8" fill="#FF5722">
    <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0.2;1" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    <animate attributeName="r" values="6;12;6" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </circle>

  <!-- Second animated indicator on hypotenuse -->
  <circle cx="275" cy="250" r="8" fill="#E91E63">
    <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.2;1;0.2" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    <animate attributeName="r" values="6;12;6" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </circle>

  <!-- Footer educational tip -->
  <text x="400" y="485" font-family="Arial" font-size="13" text-anchor="middle" fill="#6c757d">GCSE Mathematics Revision - Right-Angled Triangles</text>
</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
  <title>Parts of a Circle</title>
  
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="800" height="500" fill="#f8fafc" />
  
  <text x="400" y="45" font-size="26" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-weight="bold" fill="#1e293b" text-anchor="middle">Parts of a Circle</text>

  <!-- Centre Label & Pointer -->
  <text x="280" y="305" font-size="14" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-weight="bold" fill="#dc2626" text-anchor="middle">Centre</text>

  <text x="540" y="365" font-size="13" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" fill="#475569">Across via centre (2 × radius).</text>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
  <title>GCSE Physics Series Circuit</title>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="800" height="500" fill="#f8fafc" />

  <!-- Title & Subtitle -->
  <text x="400" y="35" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" fill="#1e293b" text-anchor="middle">Series Circuit (GCSE Physics)</text>
  <text x="400" y="58" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#64748b" text-anchor="middle">Current is the same everywhere • Voltage is shared</text>

  <!-- Circuit Wires (Outer Loop) -->
  <line x1="150" y1="220" x2="150" y2="150" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="4" />
  <line x1="150" y1="150" x2="650" y2="150" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="4" />
  <line x1="650" y1="150" x2="650" y2="220" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="4" />
  
  <line x1="650" y1="280" x2="650" y2="380" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="4" />
  <line x1="650" y1="380" x2="150" y2="380" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="4" />
  <line x1="150" y1="380" x2="150" y2="310" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="4" />

  <!-- Cell (Power Supply) on Left -->
  <rect x="120" y="220" width="60" height="90" rx="4" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0284c7" stroke-width="3" />
  <line x1="135" y1="240" x2="165" y2="240" stroke="#0284c7" stroke-width="4" />
  <line x1="145" y1="250" x2="155" y2="250" stroke="#0284c7" stroke-width="4" />
  <line x1="135" y1="265" x2="165" y2="265" stroke="#0284c7" stroke-width="4" />
  <line x1="145" y1="275" x2="155" y2="275" stroke="#0284c7" stroke-width="4" />
  <text x="100" y="260" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#0284c7" text-anchor="middle">Cell</text>
  <text x="100" y="278" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#64748b" text-anchor="middle">6 V</text>

  <!-- Component 1 (Resistor / Lamp 1) Top -->
  <rect x="300" y="125" width="80" height="50" rx="4" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e11d48" stroke-width="3" />
  <text x="340" y="110" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#e11d48" text-anchor="middle">Resistor 1</text>
  <text x="340" y="195" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#e11d48" text-anchor="middle">3 V</text>

  <!-- Component 2 (Resistor / Lamp 2) Top Right -->
  <rect x="480" y="125" width="80" height="50" rx="4" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e11d48" stroke-width="3" />
  <text x="520" y="110" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#e11d48" text-anchor="middle">Resistor 2</text>
  <text x="520" y="195" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#e11d48" text-anchor="middle">3 V</text>

  <!-- Ammeter (Bottom) -->
  <circle cx="400" cy="380" r="30" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="3" />
  <text x="400" y="385" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#16a34a" text-anchor="middle">A</text>
  <text x="400" y="430" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#16a34a" text-anchor="middle">Ammeter</text>
  <text x="400" y="448" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#64748b" text-anchor="middle">Current = 0.5 A</text>

  <!-- Explanatory Text Boxes -->
  <rect x="50" y="460" width="700" height="30" rx="5" fill="#f1f5f9" />
  <text x="400" y="480" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#334155" text-anchor="middle">Key Rule: The same current flows through every component, but the 6V supply voltage is shared equally here (3V + 3V).</text>

  <!-- Animated Current Particles (Right Wire: Top to Bottom) -->

  <circle cx="650" cy="270" r="6" fill="#eab308">

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
  <title>Photosynthesis in Plants</title>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="800" height="500" fill="white" />

  <!-- Soil / Ground -->
  <rect x="50" y="380" width="700" height="70" fill="saddlebrown" />

  <!-- Sun -->
  <circle cx="100" cy="100" r="45" fill="gold" />
  <circle cx="100" cy="100" r="55" fill="gold" opacity="0.3">
    <animate attributeName="r" values="45;65;45" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.4;0.1;0.4" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
  </circle>

  <!-- Sun Rays (represented as lines) -->
  <line x1="140" y1="120" x2="220" y2="160" stroke="gold" stroke-width="4" stroke-dasharray="8 8" />
  <line x1="120" y1="145" x2="250" y2="200" stroke="gold" stroke-width="4" stroke-dasharray="8 8" />

  <!-- Plant Stem & Roots -->
  <rect x="385" y="240" width="30" height="140" fill="forestgreen" />
  <line x1="400" y1="350" x2="350" y2="400" stroke="saddlebrown" stroke-width="6" />
  <line x1="400" y1="360" x2="450" y2="410" stroke="saddlebrown" stroke-width="6" />
  <line x1="400" y1="370" x2="400" y2="420" stroke="saddlebrown" stroke-width="6" />

  <!-- Plant Leaves (Chloroplasts / Chlorophyll) -->
  <ellipse cx="300" cy="240" rx="90" ry="50" fill="limegreen" />
  <ellipse cx="500" cy="240" rx="90" ry="50" fill="limegreen" />

  <!-- Animated Particles: Carbon Dioxide (Entering Leaf) -->
  <circle cx="160" cy="220" r="8" fill="gray">
    <animate attributeName="cx" values="160;300;160" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    <animate attributeName="cy" values="220;240;220" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0.2;1" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
  </circle>
  <circle cx="130" cy="250" r="8" fill="gray">
    <animate attributeName="cx" values="130;280;130" dur="3.5s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    <animate attributeName="cy" values="250;250;250" dur="3.5s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0.2;1" dur="3.5s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
  </circle>

  <!-- Animated Particles: Water (Entering Roots up Stem) -->
  <circle cx="400" cy="440" r="7" fill="blue">
    <animate attributeName="cy" values="440;300;440" dur="5s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0.3;1" dur="5s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
  </circle>
  <circle cx="370" cy="420" r="7" fill="blue">
    <animate attributeName="cy" values="420;280;420" dur="4.5s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0.3;1" dur="4.5s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
  </circle>

  <!-- Animated Particles: Oxygen (Leaving Leaf) -->
  <circle cx="500" cy="240" r="8" fill="deepskyblue">
    <animate attributeName="cx" values="500;640;500" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    <animate attributeName="cy" values="240;220;240" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.2;1;0.2" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
  </circle>
  <circle cx="530" cy="260" r="8" fill="deepskyblue">
    <animate attributeName="cx" values="530;670;530" dur="3.5s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    <animate attributeName="cy" values="260;240;260" dur="3.5s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.2;1;0.2" dur="3.5s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
  </circle>

  <!-- Animated Particles: Glucose (Stored in Leaf) -->
  <circle cx="350" cy="230" r="9" fill="orange">
    <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.2;1;0.2" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    <animate attributeName="r" values="6;10;6" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
  </circle>
  <circle cx="450" cy="230" r="9" fill="orange">
    <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.2;1;0.2" dur="3.5s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    <animate attributeName="r" values="6;10;6" dur="3.5s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
  </circle>

  <!-- Labels & Text -->
  <text x="400" y="45" font-family="Arial" font-size="28" font-weight="bold" fill="darkgreen" text-anchor="middle">Photosynthesis</text>
  <text x="400" y="75" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" fill="black" text-anchor="middle">Light energy is absorbed by chlorophyll to make glucose and oxygen.</text>

  <!-- Input Labels -->
  <text x="90" y="220" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="dimgray" text-anchor="middle">Carbon Dioxide</text>
  <text x="100" y="240" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="dimgray" text-anchor="middle">(from air)</text>

  <text x="100" y="155" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="goldenrod" text-anchor="middle">Light Energy</text>

  <text x="250" y="420" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="blue" text-anchor="middle">Water</text>
  <text x="250" y="440" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="blue" text-anchor="middle">(from soil)</text>

  <!-- Output Labels -->
  <text x="680" y="220" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="deepskyblue" text-anchor="middle">Oxygen</text>
  <text x="680" y="240" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="deepskyblue" text-anchor="middle">(released)</text>

  <text x="400" y="195" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="darkorange" text-anchor="middle">Glucose</text>
  <text x="400" y="215" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="darkorange" text-anchor="middle">(stored food)</text>

</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 500">
  <title>States of Matter - GCSE Chemistry</title>

  <!-- Background and Layout -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="800" height="500" fill="#f8fafc" />

  <!-- Title Banner -->
  <text x="400" y="40" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="bold" fill="#1e293b" text-anchor="middle">States of Matter</text>
  <text x="400" y="65" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#64748b" text-anchor="middle">Particle arrangement and movement in GCSE Chemistry</text>

  <!-- Solid Container & Particles -->
  <g>
    <rect x="50" y="100" width="200" height="250" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="3" />
    <text x="150" y="380" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#0284c7" text-anchor="middle">Solid</text>
    <text x="150" y="405" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#475569" text-anchor="middle">Close together &</text>
    <text x="150" y="423" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#475569" text-anchor="middle">vibrate in place</text>

    <!-- Solid Particles (Grid with slight vibration) -->
    <!-- Row 1 -->
    <circle cx="90" cy="140" r="14" fill="#0284c7">
      <animate attributeName="cx" values="90;92;88;90" dur="0.4s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>
    <circle cx="130" cy="140" r="14" fill="#0284c7">
      <animate attributeName="cx" values="130;128;132;130" dur="0.4s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>
    <circle cx="170" cy="140" r="14" fill="#0284c7">
      <animate attributeName="cx" values="170;172;168;170" dur="0.4s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>
    <circle cx="210" cy="140" r="14" fill="#0284c7">
      <animate attributeName="cx" values="210;208;212;210" dur="0.4s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>

    <!-- Row 2 -->
    <circle cx="90" cy="180" r="14" fill="#0284c7">
      <animate attributeName="cx" values="90;88;92;90" dur="0.4s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>
    <circle cx="130" cy="180" r="14" fill="#0284c7">
      <animate attributeName="cx" values="130;132;128;130" dur="0.4s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>
    <circle cx="170" cy="180" r="14" fill="#0284c7">
      <animate attributeName="cx" values="170;168;172;170" dur="0.4s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>
    <circle cx="210" cy="180" r="14" fill="#0284c7">
      <animate attributeName="cx" values="210;212;208;210" dur="0.4s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>

    <!-- Row 3 -->
    <circle cx="90" cy="220" r="14" fill="#0284c7">
      <animate attributeName="cx" values="90;92;88;90" dur="0.4s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>
    <circle cx="130" cy="220" r="14" fill="#0284c7">
      <animate attributeName="cx" values="130;128;132;130" dur="0.4s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>
    <circle cx="170" cy="220" r="14" fill="#0284c7">
      <animate attributeName="cx" values="170;172;168;170" dur="0.4s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>
    <circle cx="210" cy="220" r="14" fill="#0284c7">
      <animate attributeName="cx" values="210;208;212;210" dur="0.4s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>

    <!-- Row 4 -->
    <circle cx="90" cy="260" r="14" fill="#0284c7">
      <animate attributeName="cx" values="90;88;92;90" dur="0.4s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>
    <circle cx="130" cy="260" r="14" fill="#0284c7">
      <animate attributeName="cx" values="130;132;128;130" dur="0.4s" repeatCount="indefinite" />

    <circle cx="170" cy="260" r="14" fill="#0284c7">
      <animate attributeName="cx" values="170;168;172;170" dur="0.4s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>
    <circle cx="210" cy="260" r="14" fill="#0284c7">
      <animate attributeName="cx" values="210;212;208;210" dur="0.4s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>
  </g>

  <!-- Liquid Container & Particles -->
  <g>
    <rect x="300" y="100" width="200" height="250" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="3" />
    <text x="400" y="380" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#16a34a" text-anchor="middle">Liquid</text>
    <text x="400" y="405" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#475569" text-anchor="middle">Close, but can move</text>
    <text x="400" y="423" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#475569" text-anchor="middle">past each other</text>

    <!-- Liquid Particles (Flowing/Moving positions) -->
    <circle cx="340" cy="150" r="14" fill="#16a34a">
      <animate attributeName="cx" values="340;370;330;340" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
      <animate attributeName="cy" values="150;170;140;150" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite" />

    <circle cx="410" cy="140" r="14" fill="#16a34a">

    <circle cx="380" cy="260" r="14" fill="#16a34a">

    <circle cx="330" cy="290" r="14" fill="#16a34a">

      <animate attributeName="cy" values="290;270;300;290" dur="2.6s" repeatCount="indefinite" />

    <circle cx="450" cy="280" r="14" fill="#16a34a">

      <animate attributeName="cy" values="280;300;260;280" dur="2.4s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>
  </g>

  <!-- Gas Container & Particles -->
  <g>
    <rect x="550" y="100" width="200" height="250" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#cbd5e1" stroke-width="3" />
    <text x="650" y="380" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="bold" fill="#dc2626" text-anchor="middle">Gas</text>
    <text x="650" y="405" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#475569" text-anchor="middle">Far apart & move</text>
    <text x="650" y="423" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#475569" text-anchor="middle">randomly and fast</text>

    <!-- Gas Particles (Fast, wide random-looking movement) -->
    <circle cx="580" cy="130" r="14" fill="#dc2626">
      <animate attributeName="cx" values="580;700;600;580" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite" />

    <circle cx="680" cy="310" r="14" fill="#dc2626">

    </circle>
    <circle cx="580" cy="290" r="14" fill="#dc2626">

      <animate attributeName="cy" values="290;140;320;290" dur="1.1s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>
  </g>
</svg>
